title: Acceptance brief
description: work.briefs.body: one revision of a work item's acceptance brief. A person approves a revision before it is sent, and accepts the result against it. It carries no verdict: an agent claims criteria and a person accepts the work.

item_revision.description: The work item revision the brief was written against. An approval holds while this revision is current.

repository.description: The GitHub repository the work changes, as owner/name.

url.description: The provider's link to the item. Null for an item a person entered in Oxagen.

digest.description: The digest of the item's subject, description, and labels at that revision.

id.description: Issued by Oxagen. A criterion keeps its id through every revision, and a removed id is never issued again.

text.description: One sentence a reviewer can check.

intent.description: check: evidence can show it. review: a person judges it.

evidence.description: What the reviewer expects to see, such as a test name or a check. Empty when the criterion names none.

provenance.description: Where the criterion came from: the source item, the triage suggestion, or a person.
